title: Enchanted Southern Vancouver Island Day Trip – Private Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Travel in comfort in a luxury minivan with local guide driver who will meet you in Victoria and take you to beautiful heritage and nature up Vancouver Island. This is a tailored tour for you and your group at your pace, personalized to your interests. 
This private tour designed to take you on a journey through stunning landscapes, from scenic coastal roads to lush forests, uncovering the area’s natural beauty and fascinating history. Along the way, enjoy a leisurely lunch at a gem of a gourmet restaurant with view of the water inlets. Here you'll savour the best of Northwest cuisine and ocean views. If time allows, you'll visit select vineyards, where you can sample some of the island’s finest wines.
